decision: Owner: unify every icon and state mark on Lucide. One set, no emoji, no second icon font, no ad-hoc glyphs.

set.name: lucide
set.attribution: Lucide icons - ISC License - Copyright (c) 2022 Lucide Contributors; forked from Feather (MIT, Copyright (c) 2013-2017 Cole Bemis)

usage.markup: Inline <svg class="ui-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"> with the recorded svg_body. Decorative icons are aria-hidden; an icon-only control carries its own accessible name.
usage.css: State marks that CSS generates (selected, pressed, checked) use the matching --icon-<name> mask custom property in design-system/runtime-v2.css with background-color: currentColor. The mask carries the same recorded geometry.
usage.size: The icon inherits font size: 1em box, stroke-width 2 at 24px viewBox. Do not rescale stroke width per placement.

invariant: This file is the recorded geometry. Runtime CSS masks and sample markup must carry exactly these svg_body strings; test/ui-shell-samples.test.mjs fails when they drift. Adding an icon means adding it here first.

verification.note: Geometry was authored to the Lucide set and verified by rendering the samples in a browser on 2026-09-23. A lane with network install should diff design-system/icons.lucide.json against the lucide-static package and set upstream_diff to the checked version.
